objects.name: remoto.painelst.com
objects.description: FluxEngine operator panel ('Operador - Login'), UrlSource and payload host: /api/source-file.php returns the encrypted payload container, /template/source/<id>/<lang> the mail template, /registrar.php the victim beacon. A record 72.167.150.114 (DoH 2026-11-19). HTTP 200 in urlscan scans on 2026-11-02, 11-10, 11-11, 11-17 [verdict: malicious; source: urlscan; payload retrieved twice through an anonymising network; VirusTotal behaviour; ThreatFox 2034971]

objects.name: painelst.com
objects.description: Registrable domain of the panel: registered 2026-08-27 (Dynadot), Cloudflare name servers. ip.painelst.com is only a Cloudflare-proxied address with no TXT record, i.e. not the dead-drop zone [verdict: malicious; source: RDAP; DoH (2026-11-19)]

objects.name: taguje.com.br
objects.description: Zone name used as the Cloudflare-API dead drop in the VirusTotal sandbox run of 2026-11-12 (TXT ip.<zone> = C2 IP, TXT lurlsource.<zone> = UrlSource). A lookup key inside a Cloudflare account, not a contacted host; NXDOMAIN in public DNS and RDAP 404 on 2026-11-19, so the dead drop works without public DNS [verdict: malicious; source: VirusTotal behaviour; DoH/RDAP; ThreatFox 2034976]

objects.name: nota-fical-online.lat
objects.description: Stage host in the lure LNK: regsvr32 /i:https://nota-fical-online.lat/d/<id> scriptlet URL. Read from the LNK bytes; NXDOMAIN on 2026-11-19, scriptlet not obtained. Link to the FluxEngine loader is by shared infrastructure only [verdict: malicious; source: static analysis (this case); ThreatFox 2034977]

Panel origin since 2026-11-17 (GoDaddy, AS398101). TCP 443, 22, 9000 and 9002 open on 2026-11-19 on third-party check-host nodes (5 per port; 9000 from IR, RU, SI, US and 9002 from IR, IT, PT); the controls 9001 and 31337 were refused (one node timed out on 31337). Never contacted by us [verdict: malicious; source: DoH; urlscan; check-host (bare TCP via third-party nodes)]

Earlier panel origin (moved to 72.167.150.114 between 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-17). Opened by the previous payload build on TCP 9000 in the VirusTotal sandbox run of 2026-11-12. Passive evidence only, liveness not checked [verdict: malicious; source: VirusTotal behaviour]
Also contacted on TCP 9000 in the same VirusTotal sandbox run. Role unverified (second C2 or an unrelated host): context, not submitted to ThreatFox [verdict: candidate; source: VirusTotal behaviour]

FluxEngine control channel (JSON events, PING/PONG). The client reads the C2 IP from a DNS TXT record, so the IP is not embedded; the panel host listens here (check-host 2026-11-19) [verdict: malicious; source: static analysis + check-host; ThreatFox 2034973]
FluxEngine data and video channel (H.264 via Media Foundation, or JPEG) [verdict: malicious; source: static analysis + check-host; ThreatFox 2034974]
Previous C2 endpoint of the 2026-11-12 build (see 72.167.47.112) [verdict: malicious; source: VirusTotal behaviour; ThreatFox 2034975]
Seen in the same sandbox run, role unverified [verdict: candidate; source: VirusTotal behaviour]
